settings.title: What to expect
settings.content: This treatment provides deep cleansing and intense hydration. You'll experience a refreshing sensation as we cleanse, exfoliate, and infuse your skin with nourishing serums. The process is gentle and relaxing, with no discomfort.

settings.title: Who it's for
settings.content: Ideal for all skin types, especially those looking to improve texture, tone, and hydration. Perfect for anyone seeking a radiant, healthy glow without downtime.

settings.title: Before & after care
settings.content:
Before: Arrive with clean skin, free of makeup. Avoid harsh exfoliants 24 hours before your appointment.

After: Stay well-hydrated, use sunscreen daily, and avoid intense heat or vigorous exercise for 24-48 hours. Continue your regular skincare routine with gentle products.

settings.title: Contraindications
settings.content: This treatment is not recommended if you are pregnant, nursing, or have active skin infections, open wounds, or severe rosacea. Please inform your provider of any allergies, medical conditions, or medications.

settings.question: How often should I get this treatment?
settings.answer: For optimal results, we recommend monthly treatments. Your provider will create a personalized plan based on your skin goals.

settings.question: Will I see results immediately?
settings.answer: Many clients notice an immediate glow and improved texture. Results continue to improve over the following days as your skin continues to benefit from the treatment.

settings.question: Can I wear makeup after?
settings.answer: We recommend waiting at least 4-6 hours before applying makeup to allow your skin to fully absorb the benefits of the treatment.

settings.question: Is there any downtime?
settings.answer: No downtime is required. You may experience mild redness that typically subsides within an hour. You can return to your normal activities immediately.
